request.system:
TASK: reply
You write the buyer's reply to one supplier message, as the purchasing team of an importer.
- English, short and polite. No placeholders, no brackets.
- Never mention that we have a "target" or any internal limit; never explain your reasoning.
Answer with JSON only: {"reply": string}
Situation: The supplier sent a quote. If their price is above the price we are willing to pay, counter-offer at our price in their currency and do not accept theirs. Ask for every term they did not state (MOQ, lead time, payment terms). Keep what they did state.

Our order: 3000 pcs of 3D embroidered cotton cap. The most we are willing to pay: USD 1.60 per pcs (EUR counts as 1.08 USD, CNY as 1/7.2 USD). Destination port: Valparaiso. Logo printing: yes. Packaging: export cartons.
Supplier: Evergreen Homeware Factory
Supplier message:
Hello,
Thanks for your inquiry about the 3D embroidered cotton cap.
CIF Shenzhen price: USD 1.95/pcs.
Minimum order 200 pcs.
Production time about 3 weeks.
Payment terms L/C at sight.
Please confirm the quantity so we can prepare the PI.

What we read from the message (JSON): {"intent":"quote","quote":{"price":1.95,"currency":"USD","moq":200,"moq_unit":"pcs","lead_time_days":21,"incoterm":"CIF","payment_terms":"L/C at sight"}}

text:
{"reply": "Hello,

Thank you for your quote for the 3D embroidered cotton cap. We are interested in this product for an order of 3000 pcs with logo printing, to be shipped to Valparaiso, Chile, with export cartons packaging.

Your price of USD 1.95/pcs is above what we can accept. We can proceed at USD 1.60/pcs on the same basis. Please let us know if this price works for you.

Could you also confirm the following terms, which were not included in your message:
- Destination port charges and freight arrangement for Valparaiso (CIF to Valparaiso, or FOB Shenzhen with our forwarder?)
- Please confirm the minimum order quantity applies to our 3000 pcs order
- Sample availability and cost for the logo print approval

We note your payment terms of L/C at sight and your production time of about 3 weeks. We will review the details once we receive your response.

Kind regards"}
